description: This file defines heuristics for selecting contiguous matrix multiplication (mm) implementations in PyTorch's TorchInductor backend. It includes class definitions that register heuristics for different device contexts and implements logic to determine when to use contiguous matrix multiplication based on input tensor properties.

classes.name: EmptyContiguousMMConfigHeuristics
classes.description: A heuristic class that disables contiguous matrix multiplication on non-CUDA devices.

classes.name: ContiguousMMHeuristics
classes.description: A heuristic class that determines whether to use contiguous mm based on tensor properties and symbolic shapes.

methods.name: Generator[dict[str,Any],None,None] _get_template_configs_impl( self, kernel_inputs: KernelInputs, op_name: str, )
methods.description: Determines applicable template configurations for contiguous matrix multiplication based on kernel inputs, symbolic shape checks, and contiguity requirements.
